children: Blockaid reported an ongoing attack on X100 on Ethereum. According to Foresight News, attackers took control of two of the project’s three Senate seats and sold 400,000 X tokens from the treasury into an empty pool they created. Another attacker then destroyed a Uniswap V3 position held by Freezer, while a third used the same Senate route to withdraw the remaining approximately 550,000 X from a Uniswap V3 liquidity pool. Across three transactions, the attackers have cashed out approximately 4.85 million USDT and withdrawn about 550,000 X. Approximately 12.2 million X remain in Freezer, and the attack is ongoing.

title: Blockaid Reports Attack on Ethereum-Based X100, With About 4.85 Million USDT Cashed Out
